description: This file implements an interactive shell for managing and querying an SQLite database, providing command-line access to list tables, show schemas, describe tables, and execute SQL queries.

methods.name: print_help
methods.description: Prints help information for the interactive shell commands.

methods.name: list_tables
methods.description: Lists all tables in the current database.

methods.name: show_schema
methods.description: Shows CREATE statements for all or specific tables.

methods.name: describe_table
methods.description: Displays the structure of a specified table.

methods.name: execute_query
methods.description: Executes a given SQL query and displays the results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the script; runs the interactive shell loop.
